version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - First release as a single package: installs every shared library at once. - Library files are no longer listed in the Action List.

version.author: hsuanice
version.changelog: - First release in the hsuanice/ReaScripts repository (replaces hsuanice/PublicBeta). - Remove the PublicBeta repository in ReaPack before installing this one. - Requires the "hsuanice Library" package. - Version format is now YY.MMDD.HHMM. - FX Alias tools are now installed with AudioSweet (run them from Settings > FX Alias Tools); they no longer appear in the Action List. - Help > About now reads the version from the script header. - Full history of earlier versions: Changelogs/ in the repository (https://github.com/hsuanice/ReaScripts/tree/master/Changelogs)
